claim: Among US residents in FEMA-designated floodplains, 57% perceived lower risk than FEMA estimates and 29% were uncertain.
stance_target: public perception diverges from official hazard maps
quoted_support: Among residents in FEMA-designated floodplains, 57% perceived a lower risk than FEMA estimates, and 29% expressed uncertainty.

claim: Study authors recommend interactive mapping tools and community-based education to bridge expert-public risk perception gaps.
stance_target: evidence-based map design improves hazard comprehension
quoted_support: Interactive mapping tools and community-based education are recommended to bridge the gap between expert assessments and public perceptions.
